description: What changed in an app's store listing, newest first, with old and new values: version, release notes, title, subtitle, description, screenshots, icon, price, IAP, privacy, in-app events, badges, featuring, installs, content rating. Use it to monitor competitors ("what did X change this month?"). Cost: 1 + 1 if the US listing is refreshed credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

country.description: Only changes seen in these storefronts (comma list). Default all storefronts.

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

since.description: Only items at or after this ISO date / datetime. Example: 2026-10-01

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

name: get_app_changes
title: Get App Changes
